thread:
Maya: hey team — need help adding my spouse. ceremony in March, planned coverage 4/1, but visa stamping delayed. can i start enrollment now with provisional docs?

Sam: short answer: yes you can start the process with provisional docs, but final carrier enrollment requires the stamped passport. what's the event date and what provisional docs do you have?

Maya: married 2024-03-22. have marriage cert, USCIS receipt, and a scanned passport copy. stamp expected in June. want 4/1 effective if possible. also worried about payroll hits.

Rafael: hi @Maya — Acceptable provisional docs: marriage certificate, official visa/appointment receipts (BLS/consulate or USCIS), copy of passport, and any I-94/current authorization docs. Once stamped passport arrives upload it within 10 business days.

Sam: retro rules: if docs substantiate the event date we can request a retro effective date up to 60 days prior to the submission. Since event was 3/22 and youre requesting now, 4/1 retro looks feasible. final approval after we receive stamped passport from you.

Maya: thanks. payroll question: will I get a lump deduction? can't afford a big one in a single paycheck.

Rafael: payroll usually posts a retro deduction to reconcile premiums for the prior months. We can split the deduction across two payrolls if you notify payroll before cutoff. If hardship, fill the "retro premium plan" form in the portal within 3 business days of approval.

benefits-bot: Reminder: Upload docs via the secure portal. File naming convention suggested: dependent_docs/<lastname>_spouse_<doctype>_<yyyymmdd>.pdf. Reply "uploaded" after you add files.

Maya: uploaded marriage_chen_spouse_passport_i94_20240601.pdf and consulate_receipt_20240601.pdf. DM me link if you need copies elsewhere.

Sam: seeing uploads — Rafael will initiate QLE request and request 2024-04-01 retro effective date. Please post stamped passport image here when available.

Rafael: noted. Also include spouse full legal name and DOB here so we can prefill carrier forms.

Maya: Arun Chen, DOB 1992-11-03. appreciate the help.

Sam: thanks. we'll confirm carrier eligibility within 2 business days of receiving the stamped passport and coordinate payroll deductions per your preference. Closing loop soon.
